subject: English Home Language

source.topic: This is what I wear: Emergent Writing

show.line: Let's write e. A line across, then up and round like a curl. e, e, egg!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says e, as in egg.
This letter says e. Say the sound!
Trace e with your finger. Across, then up and round.
Look carefully. Which one is e? It has a line in the middle.

hints: e has a line in the middle and a round back.
Start in the middle. Across, then round.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write e for egg.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Round like a curl. Look, I wrote e!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is c. e needs a line in the middle.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. A line across, then round. That is e!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter e, say its sound and trace it.
